answer: Problem: cloned agent fleets mint many near-identical identities and monopolize reward seats. Mechanism: each seat must freeze a glacier-bound stake proof, solve an opal-keyed three-path maze unique to that epoch seed, then publish a beacon receipt hash before payout. Cost: aborting after maze entry burns 2.7% stake and freezes weight for two closes (poa69-e14-k7m2qx). Verification: the panel recomputes the maze receipt against escrowed bond fingerprints. Failure handling: two maze timeouts slash the bond and lock the seat until three independent attesters reopen it.
